text:
Marina (Partnerships): FYI KeyVaultCo reached out to bundle a KMS/HSM connector + SAML/SCIM for Redwood Private. They want to surface it on the marketplace and co-host a launch. Can we quick align on owners? :wave:
Dev (Security Eng): I can do attestation checks and a small failure-mode test (HSM unreachable -> retry/backoff). Need their PKCS#11 docs and certs.
Carlos (Product): We'll list as partner-managed with optional Redwood onboarding. Need SKU and basic support matrix.
Asha (Solutions): I'll draft SCIM group->role examples and a short SI runbook for secrets-sync installation.
Tom (Legal): Please request SOC2 and any export-control notes. If keys can be exported by default we need opt-in in the UI and contract.
marketplace-bot: New ticket partners/keyvaultco-kms-hsm (#2785) created.
Marina (Partnerships): Proposed timeline: this week discovery + cert exchange; next week connector dev; week after closed beta. Anyone want to add test items?
Dev (Security Eng): Add log-redaction verification and key-rotation exercise to the e2e checklist.
Carlos (Product): Also confirm networking model: partner-hosted endpoint vs customer VPC peering. That affects docs and billing.
Marina (Partnerships): Great. I'll schedule a kickoff with KeyVaultCo and the SI for Friday 9am PT. Drop any pre-reads here. :white_check_mark:
